svg.aria-label: Daily doodle for July 29, 2026 — International Tiger Day. A jungle-noir tableau: on the left, a large stylized tiger head with glowing amber eyes and sweeping black stripes on ember-orange fur, enclosed in a subtle emblem ring, behind a curtain of dark bamboo stalks with pale leaves; low jungle mist rolls across the bottom; drifting fireflies rise through the frame; on the right, a large amber JULY 29, 2026 headline; ember-orange INTERNATIONAL TIGER DAY subhead; italic PANTHERA TIGRIS · TX2 · 2010 SAINT PETERSBURG SUMMIT tertiary.
